name: FeedHive
desc: Schedule, manage and publish social media content with FeedHive.

actions.name: create_post
actions.description: Creates a new post in FeedHive (draft or scheduled).

actions.name: update_post
actions.description: Updates an existing post in FeedHive. Only the fields you fill in will be changed.

actions.name: get_post
actions.description: Retrieves the details of a specific post.

actions.name: delete_post
actions.description: Deletes a post from FeedHive. This action cannot be undone.

actions.name: list_posts
actions.description: Returns a list of posts, optionally filtered by status or labels.

actions.name: create_label
actions.description: Creates a new label in FeedHive for organising posts.

actions.name: fire_workflow_trigger
actions.description: Fires a FeedHive Workflow Trigger to create a post. The workflow defines which accounts to post to, the AI model to use, and any default content.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: post_notification
triggers.description: Triggers when a post is published, scheduled, or fails.

triggers.name: comment_notification
triggers.description: Triggers when a comment is added to one of your posts.
